user_requirement: More task kinds, broader coverage, and all-in-one evaluation relative to prior work.

human_observation_conditioned_tasks.unit: G2 task specifications with valid human-observation and robot-execution pairing

coverage.counting_rule: common fixed context/family/interaction-mechanism ontology with verified tasks and explicit embodiment eligibility
coverage.required_comparison: shared, additional and missing cells for every preregistered comparator

existing_design.role: seed designs, examples and potential evaluation anchors; not a ceiling on the full task bank

capacity_example.qualification: Conditional planning assignments; actual uniqueness, information sufficiency, intervention applicability and model eligibility must be audited.

anti_inflation_rules: Do not add an integration hub's upstream tasks to those same source tasks.
Do not convert native IDs, class declarations, activity directories or generator configs silently into canonical tasks.
Do not count object color, pose, view, paraphrase, robot replacement or policy repeats as new G2 tasks without genuine semantic changes.
Keep data resources, offline QA items, physical control cases and rollouts separate.
Compare whole resources and actual evaluated subsets in separate columns.
Do not claim 'largest' before common-ontology, version and scope comparisons are complete.
